blocks.AB_ON_START_TOOLTIP: Runs once when the game starts.
blocks.AB_ON_UPDATE_TOOLTIP: Runs on every frame, 30 times per second.
blocks.AB_ON_EVERY_TOOLTIP: Runs again and again with this many milliseconds between.
blocks.AB_ON_DRAW_TOOLTIP: Draw your own graphics here. Runs after the sprites are drawn.
blocks.AB_SPLASH_TOOLTIP: Shows a message and waits until A is pressed.
blocks.AB_GAME_OVER_TOOLTIP: Ends the game and shows the score.
blocks.AB_PAUSE_TOOLTIP: Waits for a number of milliseconds.
blocks.AB_INVERT_TOOLTIP: Swaps black and white on the screen.
blocks.AB_SPRITE_CREATE_TOOLTIP: Creates a new sprite in the middle of the screen.
blocks.AB_SPRITE_PROJECTILE_TOOLTIP: Creates a moving sprite that disappears when it leaves the screen.
blocks.AB_SPRITE_SET_PROP_TOOLTIP: Sets a value of a sprite.
blocks.AB_SPRITE_CHANGE_PROP_TOOLTIP: Changes a value of a sprite.
blocks.AB_SPRITE_SET_POSITION_TOOLTIP: Moves the sprite. x and y are the middle of the sprite.
blocks.AB_SPRITE_SET_IMAGE_TOOLTIP: Changes the picture of the sprite.
blocks.AB_SPRITE_SET_FLAG_TOOLTIP: Turns a behaviour of the sprite on or off.
blocks.AB_SPRITE_ANIMATE_TOOLTIP: Shows the frames of the image one after another. 0 stops.
blocks.AB_SPRITE_DESTROY_ALL_TOOLTIP: Removes all sprites of a kind.
blocks.AB_ON_OVERLAP: on %1 of kind %2 overlaps %3 of kind %4
blocks.AB_SPRITE_OVERLAPS_TOOLTIP: True if the two sprites touch.
blocks.AB_SPRITE_IS_HITTING_TOOLTIP: True if the sprite hit a wall or the screen edge on that side in this frame.
blocks.AB_SPRITE_IS_KIND_TOOLTIP: True if the sprite is of this kind.
blocks.AB_SPRITE_SET_KIND_TOOLTIP: Changes the kind of the sprite.
blocks.AB_SPRITE_EXISTS_TOOLTIP: True if the sprite has not been destroyed.
blocks.AB_FOR_EACH_KIND_TOOLTIP: Runs the blocks inside once for every sprite of the kind.
blocks.AB_ON_BUTTON_TOOLTIP: Runs when a button is pressed or released.
blocks.AB_IS_PRESSED_TOOLTIP: True while the button is held down.
blocks.AB_MOVE_SPRITE_TOOLTIP: The direction buttons move the sprite. Use 0 to lock a direction.
blocks.AB_SET_TILEMAP_TOOLTIP: Shows a tile map. Solid tiles work as walls.
blocks.AB_CAMERA_FOLLOW_TOOLTIP: Moves the view so the sprite stays in the middle.
blocks.AB_SET_CAMERA_TOOLTIP: Moves the view. x and y are the top left corner.
blocks.AB_CAMERA_X_TOOLTIP: Left edge of the view in the world.
blocks.AB_CAMERA_Y_TOOLTIP: Top edge of the view in the world.
blocks.AB_SPAWN_ON_TILES: on every %1 tile place sprite %2 of kind %3
blocks.AB_SPAWN_ON_TILES_TOOLTIP: Creates a sprite on each tile of this type and removes the tile.
blocks.AB_ON_TILE: on %1 of kind %2 overlaps tile %3 at %4 %5
blocks.AB_ON_TILE_TOOLTIP: Runs when a sprite touches a tile. The column and row of the tile are in the variables.
blocks.AB_SET_TILE: set tile at col %1 row %2 to %3
blocks.AB_SET_TILE_TOOLTIP: Changes one tile of the map.
blocks.AB_TILE_IS_TOOLTIP: True if the tile is of this type.
blocks.AB_PLACE_ON_TILE_TOOLTIP: Moves the sprite to the middle of a tile.
blocks.AB_SCORE_SET_TOOLTIP: Sets the score. It is shown in the top right corner.
blocks.AB_LIFE_SET_TOOLTIP: Sets the number of lives. They are shown as hearts.
blocks.AB_LIFE_CHANGE_TOOLTIP: Adds to the lives. At 0 the game is over.
blocks.AB_ON_LIFE_ZERO_TOOLTIP: Runs when the lives reach 0, instead of game over.
blocks.AB_HISCORE_TOOLTIP: The best score, saved on the device.
blocks.AB_STORAGE_SAVE_TOOLTIP: Saves a number that is kept when the device is turned off. Slots 0 to 31.
blocks.AB_DRAW_PIXEL_TOOLTIP: Draws one pixel. Use inside "on draw".
blocks.AB_DRAW_LINE: draw line from x %1 y %2 to x %3 y %4 %5
blocks.AB_DRAW_LINE_TOOLTIP: Draws a line. Use inside "on draw".
blocks.AB_DRAW_RECT: draw %1 rectangle x %2 y %3 w %4 h %5 %6
blocks.AB_DRAW_RECT_TOOLTIP: Draws a rectangle. Use inside "on draw".
blocks.AB_DRAW_CIRCLE_TOOLTIP: Draws a circle. Use inside "on draw".
blocks.AB_DRAW_IMAGE_TOOLTIP: Draws an image with its top left corner at x and y.
blocks.AB_GET_PIXEL: pixel at x %1 y %2 is on
blocks.AB_GET_PIXEL_TOOLTIP: True if the pixel is white.
blocks.AB_PLAY_TONE_TOOLTIP: Plays a tone. 440 Hz is the note A.
blocks.AB_RANDOM_TOOLTIP: A random whole number between the two numbers.
blocks.AB_MINMAX_TOOLTIP: The smaller or the bigger of two numbers.
blocks.AB_CPP_TOOLTIP: C++ code that is copied into the game. It runs on the device, but not in the simulator.
